summary: Frontend testing for Phase 8A: New Lead + Package integration in Sales Pipeline. All 6 acceptance criteria PASSED.

detailed_results.1_dialog_opens_with_package_input: PASS - add-lead-button opens lead-dialog with lead-package-input visible
detailed_results.2_dropdown_lists_active_packages: PASS - focusing input opens lead-package-dropdown with 5 ACTIVE options (Umrah Reguler 9 Hari, Turkey Tour 8 Hari, Umroh Private Test, Tour Open Trip Test, SIC Test). Each option shows name, code, product_type, destination, duration, departure_date, price, seat. Typing 'Umrah' filters to 1 option; 'Turkey' filters to 1 option.
detailed_results.3_destination_autofills_readonly: PASS - selecting Umrah Reguler 9 Hari sets destination to 'Makkah & Madinah'. Input has both disabled=true and readOnly=true. Attempted keyboard typing did not alter value.
detailed_results.4_destination_updates_on_package_change: PASS - switching to Turkey Tour 8 Hari updates destination to 'Istanbul & Cappadocia'.
detailed_results.5_save_success_and_validation: PASS - Save with pax=2, budget=50000000 succeeded; toast 'Lead created' shown; dialog closed; new lead card appeared in NEW column showing 'Turkey Tour 8 Hari'. Save without package selection shows sonner toast 'Interested Package wajib dipilih' and dialog stays open.
detailed_results.6_regression: PASS - Kanban board renders all stage columns; existing lead cards (Ahmad Fauzi/Umrah Reguler 9 Hari, Siti Rahma/Umrah Plus Turki 12 Hari, Alex Jordan, Budi Santoso, etc.) render correctly. Stage move Select is present on cards (data-testid=move-stage-*).

critical_code_review_comments: SalesPipeline.jsx uses id from lead-packages as destination_id (same as package.id). Backend acceptance says destination_id/destination_name are FK to Package Master destinations - if there is a separate Destination collection with its own IDs, the frontend is passing the package id, not a real destination_id. Verify with main agent whether backend expects destination FK from a Destinations table or is fine with package.id (per playbook it appears backend re-enriches from package_id server-side so this is likely acceptable, but noted).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test lead during testing, deleted via DELETE /api/leads/{id} after verification (status=200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 8A acceptance criteria verified end-to-end in Sales UI. PackageCombobox works as spec'd. Note: destination_id passed from frontend equals package.id (see code line 85) - backend enriches destination_id/destination_name from package_id so this is fine per the reviewer note that backend was curl-verified.
